_comment: GENERATED by registry/build.py. Do not edit by hand. Offline seed used by POST /marketplace/plugins/sync when MARKETPLACE_REGISTRY_URL is unreachable (air-gapped or first-run installs). Identical in shape and content to the published catalogue, so a later online sync upserts the same rows instead of colliding with them.

plugins.name: Config Drift Guard
plugins.short_description: Compares your sites against a declared baseline and reports what has drifted.

schedules.name: drift_scan
schedules.description: Run every enabled drift check and raise or resolve alerts. Read-only against your gear; it inspects the inventory FreeSDN already holds.

plugins.description: Compares your sites against a declared baseline and reports what has drifted. Checks site parity (every site should have the same kinds of device), naming conventions, PoE state on ports that should have it, and devices that have been offline too long. Raises alerts, and can stage a correction for operator approval.

plugins.name: Hello World
plugins.short_description: A minimal example plugin that demonstrates the FreeSDN Plugin SDK. Lists offline devices, creates alerts, emits events, stores settings, and exposes a custom REST endpoint.
plugins.description: A minimal example plugin that demonstrates the FreeSDN Plugin SDK. Lists offline devices, creates alerts, emits events, stores settings, and exposes a custom REST endpoint.

plugins.name: Home Assistant Bridge
plugins.short_description: Publishes network state into Home Assistant as sensors, so the automations you already have can react to the network. Estate totals, availability, and a problem sensor per site.

schedules.name: state_push
schedules.description: Publish current network state to Home Assistant. Enabled by default, unlike the sync plugins: this only writes sensor state to your own dashboard and cannot change anything on the network.

plugins.description: Publishes network state into Home Assistant as sensors, so the automations you already have can react to the network. Estate totals, availability, and a problem sensor per site. Write-only: it sets sensor state and nothing else.

plugins.name: Jira Tickets
plugins.short_description: Opens a Jira issue when a FreeSDN alert fires and closes it when the alert resolves.
plugins.description: Opens a Jira issue when a FreeSDN alert fires and closes it when the alert resolves. One issue per alert, deduplicated across repeat firings, with a severity floor so only what you care about becomes work.

plugins.name: LibreNMS Sync
plugins.short_description: Adds the devices FreeSDN already knows about to LibreNMS, so a new switch does not have to be typed into two systems. Runs dry by default, never deletes, and reports what it skipped and why.

schedules.name: device_sync
schedules.description: Add any FreeSDN devices missing from LibreNMS. Honours the dry_run setting, which defaults on. Ships DISABLED: an unattended write into somebody's monitoring system should be a deliberate decision.

plugins.description: Adds the devices FreeSDN already knows about to LibreNMS, so a new switch does not have to be typed into two systems. Runs dry by default, never deletes, and reports what it skipped and why.

plugins.name: NetBox Sync
plugins.short_description: Pushes the FreeSDN device inventory into NetBox as devices and sites.

schedules.name: inventory_sync
schedules.description: Reconcile FreeSDN's inventory against NetBox. Honours the dry_run setting, which defaults on. Ships DISABLED: an unattended write into an external system of record should be a deliberate decision.

plugins.description: Pushes the FreeSDN device inventory into NetBox as devices and sites. Runs dry by default so you can see exactly what would change before anything does, and reports conflicts rather than overwriting them.

plugins.name: New Device Watch
plugins.short_description: Raises an alert when a device appears that is not on your allowlist.

schedules.name: inventory_audit
schedules.description: Sweep the whole inventory for devices that are not on the allowlist. Catches what the event path cannot see: anything that appeared while the plugin was not running, or before it was installed.

plugins.description: Raises an alert when a device appears that is not on your allowlist. Matches by MAC, by OUI vendor prefix, or by device type, and can hold new devices for review during a learning period so an existing network does not alert on everything at once.

plugins.name: PagerDuty Incidents
plugins.short_description: Triggers a PagerDuty incident when a FreeSDN alert fires and resolves it when the alert clears.
plugins.description: Triggers a PagerDuty incident when a FreeSDN alert fires and resolves it when the alert clears. Deduplicated by PagerDuty itself on the alert id, with a severity floor so only what should wake someone does.

plugins.name: Port Hygiene
plugins.short_description: Finds the switch-port problems nothing else looks for: ports enabled with no link for weeks, links negotiating half duplex, climbing error counters, live ports on the default VLAN, and switches…

schedules.name: port_scan
schedules.description: Walk every switch port and report what has gone wrong. Read-only against your gear: it inspects the port tables FreeSDN already holds. Six-hourly, because none of these conditions appear in minutes.

plugins.description: Finds the switch-port problems nothing else looks for: ports enabled with no link for weeks, links negotiating half duplex, climbing error counters, live ports on the default VLAN, and switches running out of PoE headroom. Reports only, never changes a port.

plugins.name: ServiceNow Incidents
plugins.short_description: Creates a ServiceNow incident when a FreeSDN alert fires and resolves it when the alert clears.
plugins.description: Creates a ServiceNow incident when a FreeSDN alert fires and resolves it when the alert clears. One incident per alert, deduplicated across repeat firings, with an explicit severity-to-urgency mapping.

plugins.name: Snipe-IT Sync
plugins.short_description: Creates asset records in Snipe-IT for hardware FreeSDN finds on the network, so warranty, cost and ownership are tracked from the day a device appears.

schedules.name: asset_sync
schedules.description: Create Snipe-IT assets for any hardware FreeSDN has found and Snipe-IT does not have. Honours dry_run, which defaults on.

plugins.description: Creates asset records in Snipe-IT for hardware FreeSDN finds on the network, so warranty, cost and ownership are tracked from the day a device appears. Create-only: it never overwrites an existing asset. Runs dry by default.

plugins.name: Zabbix Sync
plugins.short_description: Creates Zabbix hosts for the devices FreeSDN finds, so a new switch is monitored without being typed into a second system. Runs dry by default, never deletes, and reports what it skipped and why.

schedules.name: host_sync
schedules.description: Create Zabbix hosts for any FreeSDN devices Zabbix does not have. Honours dry_run, which defaults on.

plugins.description: Creates Zabbix hosts for the devices FreeSDN finds, so a new switch is monitored without being typed into a second system. Runs dry by default, never deletes, and reports what it skipped and why.
